title: kt-witness — endpoints and reliance
description: Is anyone relying on this witness? Outside traffic per endpoint, latency, and availability. Companion to the kt-witness performance dashboard.

panels.title: Is anyone relying on it? — outside traffic only (arrived via the tunnel; excludes /metrics and /healthz)
External requests (time range)
panels.description: Every request from an outside party in the selected range. Zero means nobody used the witness in that window.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "server")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stack == "kt-witness" and r._field == "kt_witness_http_requests_total" and r.via == "tunnel" and r.route != "/metrics" and r.route != "/healthz")
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

panels.title: Distinct external clients (24h)
panels.description: Distinct Cf-Connecting-Ip addresses seen through the tunnel in the trailing 24 hours, across all routes. Held only as a hash, in memory; resets on restart.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "server")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stack == "kt-witness" and r._field == "kt_witness_http_distinct_clients" and r.route == "all")
  |> last() |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

panels.title: Cosigned checkpoints read (time range)
panels.description: Successful GET /<origin-hash>/checkpoint from outside: someone fetching what this witness signed. This is the strongest signal of reliance.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "server")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stack == "kt-witness" and r._field == "kt_witness_http_requests_total" and r.via == "tunnel" and r.route != "/metrics" and r.route != "/healthz" and r.route == "/{origin}/checkpoint" and r.code == "200")
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

panels.title: Pushes cosigned (time range)
panels.description: POST /add-checkpoint answered 200: a log asked for, and got, our cosignature. Counted by the push handler, so it includes pushes over the LAN.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "server")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stack == "kt-witness" and r._field == "kt_witness_push_requests_total" and r.status == "200")
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

panels.title: External requests / min, by route
panels.description: Per-series rate, then summed by route.

targets.query:
// Rate windows are floored at four scrapes (15s): see deploy/RUNBOOK.md.
w = if int(v: v.windowPeriod) < 60000000000 then 1m else v.windowPeriod

from(bucket: "server")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stack == "kt-witness" and r._field == "kt_witness_http_requests_total" and r.via == "tunnel" and r.route != "/metrics" and r.route != "/healthz")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: w, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1m, nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["route"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: w, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "route"])

panels.title: External requests / min, by status class
panels.description: 4xx on /{origin}/checkpoint means a client asked for a log we have no cosignature for (or have withheld); 4xx on /add-checkpoint is the protocol talking (409 = size mismatch).

targets.query:
import "strings"
// Rate windows are floored at four scrapes (15s): see deploy/RUNBOOK.md.
w = if int(v: v.windowPeriod) < 60000000000 then 1m else v.windowPeriod

from(bucket: "server")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stack == "kt-witness" and r._field == "kt_witness_http_requests_total" and r.via == "tunnel" and r.route != "/metrics" and r.route != "/healthz")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with class: strings.substring(v: r.code, start: 0, end: 1) + "xx"}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: w, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1m, nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["class"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: w, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "class"])

panels.title: Most-read cosignatures (time range), by log
panels.description: Which logs' cosigned checkpoints outside parties fetch. A log never read here is one nobody checks our signature on.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "server")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stack == "kt-witness" and r._field == "kt_witness_checkpoint_fetches_total" and r.via == "tunnel")
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 25)
  |> keep(columns: ["origin", "_value"])

panels.title: Push outcomes / min, by status
panels.description: 200 cosigned · 409 size mismatch or race (the log retries) · 403 bad log signature or forked log · 422 bad proof · 429 over qpd · 503 withheld (stale, signer).

targets.query:
// Rate windows are floored at four scrapes (15s): see deploy/RUNBOOK.md.
w = if int(v: v.windowPeriod) < 60000000000 then 1m else v.windowPeriod

from(bucket: "server")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stack == "kt-witness" and r._field == "kt_witness_push_requests_total")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: w, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1m, nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["status"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: w, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "status"])

panels.title: Distinct external clients (trailing 24h), by route
panels.description: A gauge over a rolling 24h window; it resets to zero on restart.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "server")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stack == "kt-witness" and r._field == "kt_witness_http_distinct_clients" and r.route != "all")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["route"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "route"])

panels.title: Latency — outside traffic, as served by the witness (excludes Cloudflare's own time)

targets.query:
import "math"
// Rate windows are floored at four scrapes (15s): see deploy/RUNBOOK.md.
w = if int(v: v.windowPeriod) < 60000000000 then 1m else v.windowPeriod

from(bucket: "server")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stack == "kt-witness" and r._field == "kt_witness_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket" and r.via == "tunnel" and r.route != "/metrics" and r.route != "/healthz")
  |> group(columns: ["route", "le"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: w, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with le: if r.le == "+Inf" then math.mInf(sign: 1) else float(v: r.le)}))
  |> group(columns: ["route", "_time"])
  |> histogramQuantile(quantile: 0.5, upperBoundColumn: "le", countColumn: "_value", valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not math.isNaN(f: r._value))
  |> group(columns: ["route"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "route"])

panels.title: p95 latency by route
panels.description: From the cumulative le buckets (1ms … 10s). A value in the top bucket means over 10s.

panels.title: Mean latency by route
panels.description: Sum / count per window: moves with every request, where the quantiles need enough samples to be meaningful.

targets.query:
// Rate windows are floored at four scrapes (15s): see deploy/RUNBOOK.md.
w = if int(v: v.windowPeriod) < 60000000000 then 1m else v.windowPeriod

s = from(bucket: "server")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stack == "kt-witness" and r._field == "kt_witness_http_request_duration_seconds_sum" and r.via == "tunnel" and r.route != "/metrics" and r.route != "/healthz")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: w, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["route", "_time"]) |> sum()
c = from(bucket: "server")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stack == "kt-witness" and r._field == "kt_witness_http_request_duration_seconds_count" and r.via == "tunnel" and r.route != "/metrics" and r.route != "/healthz")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: w, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["route", "_time"]) |> sum()
join(tables: {s: s, c: c}, on: ["route", "_time"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value_c > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, route: r.route, _value: r._value_s / r._value_c}))
  |> group(columns: ["route"])

panels.title: Public /healthz probe (HTTP code)
panels.description: Telegraf http_response probing https://witness.gdbsecurity.com/healthz through Cloudflare — the path clients take. Empty means the probe input is not configured: see deploy/grafana/README.md.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "server")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_response" and r.server == "https://witness.gdbsecurity.com/healthz" and r._field == "http_response_code")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Since process start. No value means the scrape is failing, i.e. the witness is down or unreachable on the LAN.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "server")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stack == "kt-witness" and r._field == "kt_witness_process_start_time_seconds")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: float(v: uint(v: now()) / uint(v: 1000000000)) - r._value}))

// Rate windows are floored at four scrapes (15s): see deploy/RUNBOOK.md.
w = if int(v: v.windowPeriod) < 60000000000 then 1m else v.windowPeriod

from(bucket: "server")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stack == "kt-witness" and r._field == "kt_witness_http_requests_total" and r.code =~ /^5/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: w, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1m, nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["route"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: w, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "route"])
